title: Tribes critical probability deficit
statement: For each natural number $w$, define the critical probability deficit to be one half minus the uniform probability that the critical tribes function on the sign cube of dimension $d_w$ takes the value $-1$, where $d_w$ is the critical dimension used in the tribes construction.
caveat: The payload gives no definitions of the critical dimension or critical tribes function.
